reason: Reply B is built around what this landlord actually holds against the tenant: it leads with the 2024 late payments, cuts the "more than the restaurant can carry" line that would signal fragility to someone weighing a chain, and adds an accurate five-year-gap figure (about $14,000, under three months of vacancy) plus a firm signing date. Reply A has sound points but is more generic negotiation advice, and its suggestions to open below $5,100 and to spell out that his asking rate is above market risk irritating a landlord who already feels he has been generous.
